description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Holy with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Dual Awoken Knight Mode I (Curilla)] to the user, grants [XI Resonance +3% Boost] to all FFXI allies

description.name: Dual Awoken Knight Mode I (Curilla)
description.text: Knight abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Knight abilities trigger 2 additional times, grants [Quick Cast 1] to all allies in the character's row after using Knight abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Knight Mode II (Curilla)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Knight Mode II (Curilla)
description.text: Knight abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, instant cast speed for Knight abilities, grants [Buff Holy 30% (15s)]/[ATK, DEF, MAG and RES +15% (8s)] to all allies if 0-3/4+ FF11 allies are alive, causes [Imperil Prismatic 20% (15s)] if 4+ FF11 allies are alive

description.name: Buff Holy 30% (15s)
description.text: Increases Holy damage dealt by 30%, cumulable

description.name: Imperil Prismatic 20% (15s)
description.text: Causes [Imperil Fire 20% (15s)], [Imperil Ice 20% (15s)], [Imperil Lightning 20% (15s)], [Imperil Earth 20% (15s)], [Imperil Wind 20% (15s)], [Imperil Water 20% (15s)], [Imperil Holy 20% (15s)], [Imperil Dark 20% (15s)] and [Imperil Poison 20% (15s)]

description.name: Attach Holy with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Holy Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Holy 3

description.name: XI Resonance +3% Boost
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 3% if the character's Realm is XI
